name: Shizuki Shiori
source: Shizuki Yuri's little sister. She is a bright and honest girl, who loves her big sister very much. As she is younger, her body is not as developed as that of her sister. As Shiori discovers her big sister's sufferings, she tried her best to help in fighting against the molesters.
